content: Hey, we need to talk. I know you’re upset, but honestly, you’re blowing things way out of proportion. I don’t even know why you’re making such a big deal out of nothing. You’re twisting things in your head, and it’s not fair to accuse me when I’ve done nothing wrong. Maybe if you trusted me more and weren’t so paranoid, we wouldn’t be in this mess. You really need to think about how you’re seeing things, because it’s not the reality.
